extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A comparison of two quantities by division.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A ratio with a denominator of 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that can be expressed as a fraction of two integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Irrational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that cannot be expressed as a simple fraction.

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest Common Factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The largest positive integer that divides each of the integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Least Common Multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The smallest positive integer that is divisible by each of the integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The non-negative value of a number without regard to its sign.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number indicating how many times a base is multiplied by itself.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An algebraic expression of degree one.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical statement asserting the equality of two expressions.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relation between two values that are not equal.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportional Relationship
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relationship where two quantities have a constant ratio.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change between two variables in a linear relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function whose graph is a straight line.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relation that assigns exactly one output to each input.

extracted_concepts.name: Transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mapping that changes the position or size of a geometric figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Congruence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two figures are congruent if they have the same shape and size.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: In a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of squares of the other two sides.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The amount of space occupied by a three-dimensional object.

extracted_concepts.name: Surface Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The total area of the surface of a three-dimensional object.

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter Plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A graph using Cartesian coordinates to display values for typically two variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical Question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A question that anticipates variability in data.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The average of a data set, calculated by summing values and dividing by count.

extracted_concepts.name: Median
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The middle value in an ordered data set.

extracted_concepts.name: Interquartile Range
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The difference between the third and first quartiles of a data set.
